business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Dilutive Revenue-Based Financing for Digital Brands

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with autonomous administrative law jurisdiction and EU-law primacy)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Articles L. 561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT customer due diligence and beneficial-owner obligations, as amended by Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843) and Articles L. 561-45-1, L. 561-46, and L. 561-47 (beneficial-owner declaration and register); Code de commerce, Articles R. 123-220 to R. 123-222 (deposit and publication rules for the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); implementing ACPR and TRACFIN guidance.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and corporate existence (Extrait Kbis or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified UBO declaration excerpt (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies of all shareholders, directors, and disclosed UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary/Certified translator in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Compliance Status of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for incorporation representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors and counterparties against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, United Nations Security Council sanctions, OFAC SDN list, French TRACFIN indicators, and national PEP databases prior to filing the UBO declaration; ongoing monitoring under Article L. 561-6-1 of the Code monétaire et financier with escalation for politically exposed persons and negative media review; enhanced identity verification and source-of-funds evidence required for any nominee or intermediary chain exceeding one layer.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.inpi.fr) and Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr) for RCS name availability verification
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name (dénomination sociale) must be entered in Latin characters for the RCS file; non-Latin script elements may be used in the brand name only if accompanied by a mandatory Latin-character transliteration and a certified French translation; the name must be lawful, non-misleading, distinguishable from existing registered names, and free of terms reserved by law.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: France / République / National (when used in a misleading official capacity)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Guichet Unique or the Greffe rejects the proposed name, counsel must obtain the written rejection grounds, correct the proposed name and refile through the Guichet Unique using the same incorporation folder within 30 days; for a substantive rejection on regulatory grounds (reserved tokens), an administrative request for review may be filed with the INPI within 15 days, and judicial recourse before the competent Tribunal judiciaire (commercial chamber) is available within 2 months of the rejection decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Limited acceptance. A SAS may be domiciled at the premises of a licensed commercial domiciliation provider for a transitional term of up to 5 years, but for an ISIC 6499 royalty-financing activity the authorities require a real executive management presence, local directors, full accounting books and records kept in France, and an operational substance appropriate to the medium-risk AML/CFT classification; a purely virtual office without any French operational footprint exposes the entity to TRACFIN/ACPR intervention, tax abuse-of-law recharacterization, and refusal of French bank account opening.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 35% in the first 24 months after incorporation for a medium-risk financing-focused SAS; the probability rises to above 55% if counterparties or payees are in high-risk jurisdictions or if the UBO structure includes nominees; ordinary low-risk commercial entities would face lower than 10% inspection probability absent adverse indicators.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, principally Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 and R.227-1 to R.227-2 governing sociétés par actions simplifiées; Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. governing the Trade and Companies Register and registration formalities; Monetary and Financial Code provisions apply separately if the business constitutes regulated credit, lending, payment, investment, or fund activity.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI), with registration in the Registre du commerce et des sociétés maintained by the competent commercial court registry (greffe du tribunal de commerce).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of creation and application for registration in the Registre du commerce et des sociétés through the INPI Guichet unique, supported by the signed SAS articles of association and beneficial ownership declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to an ordinary SAS. The articles determine the share capital, and at least 50% of cash contributions must be paid upon subscription; the balance may be paid within five years. Contributions in kind generally require an independent contribution auditor unless the statutory exemptions are satisfied. Capital is normally deposited in a temporary account with a French bank, notary, or authorised payment institution, which issues the certificate of deposit before registration. The stated USD amount is an approximate conversion of the ordinary RCS registration fee of EUR 37.45 and excludes the separate beneficial ownership filing fee and any publication or professional charges.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders having incorporated the Company, the President acknowledges the valid subscription of all issued shares and confirms that the required cash contributions have been deposited in accordance with the articles. The registered office is adopted at [full French address]. [Name] is appointed President for the term and under the powers specified in the articles. [Name] is appointed Directeur Général, if applicable, with the authority specified in the articles. The officers are authorised to complete all INPI, RCS, tax, banking, beneficial ownership, AML, and regulatory filings necessary to commence lawful operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm Regulatory Perimeter and Corporate Design
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF) and Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution (ACPR), where the business model falls within their respective mandates
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Document the financing model, source of funds, investor profile, contractual return, credit decision process, receivables structure, and payment flows. Obtain French regulatory advice before incorporation if the company will habitually grant credit, collect repayable funds from the public, provide payment services, manage collective investments, or operate a regulated investment fund. Confirm whether the activity is proprietary financing outside the regulated perimeter or requires authorisation, registration, or a licensed partner.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the model is classified as regulated, suspend launch, revise the activity perimeter, appoint an authorised French or EEA partner, or submit the required ACPR or AMF application before soliciting funds or granting regulated credit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve and Verify the Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique and the competent commercial court registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure a qualifying registered office in France and obtain evidence of occupancy. The address may be a premises, domiciliation company, or eligible officer residence subject to statutory conditions. Ensure that the corporate purpose and principal activity are consistent with the proposed ISIC 6499 and French NAF classification.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease, domiciliation agreement, or proof of residence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace defective address evidence, obtain landlord or domiciliation consent, and resubmit the address attachment through the INPI portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare, Execute, and Publish the Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal counsel, shareholders, and an authorised journal of legal announcements (journal d'annonces légales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the SAS articles in French, including capital, share classes, transfer restrictions, governance, President powers, approval rights, financial year, and dissolution provisions. Execute the articles electronically or by wet signature. Arrange the mandatory incorporation announcement in an authorised journal in the department of the registered office. Notarisation is not generally required unless a notarial deed or qualifying real-estate contribution is involved.
required_dossiers: Shareholders' identification and corporate authority evidence
Appointment acceptance of the President and any Directeur Général
Statement of non-conviction and parentage for each individual officer
Certificate of publication of the legal announcement
Contribution auditor report or waiver, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct incomplete signatures, corporate powers, officer declarations, or mandatory clauses; republish the announcement if the notice contains a material error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open the Capital Deposit Account and Fund the Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank, authorised payment institution, or French notary accepting corporate capital deposits
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed articles, identification documents, ownership chart, source-of-funds evidence, and proposed capital table to the depositary. Transfer the subscribed cash capital, obtain the certificate of deposit, and retain evidence of each shareholder's payment. Complete enhanced AML documentation because financing businesses may receive heightened source-of-funds scrutiny.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to KYC or source-of-funds queries, replace unacceptable payment evidence, or use another eligible depositary. Do not file without a valid capital deposit certificate where the filing requires one.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Incorporation and Beneficial Ownership Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique, transmitting the filing to the competent RCS greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic creation formalité, select the SAS legal form, upload the signed articles and supporting documents, declare the President and other officers, identify the principal activity, and file the beneficial ownership declaration. Pay the applicable RCS, beneficial ownership, publication, and ancillary charges. Verify that all personal data, activity descriptions, capital amounts, and dates match across documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Monitor the INPI dashboard and answer any greffe or INPI query within the stated deadline. Upload corrected documents, pay any supplementary fee, and resubmit the formalité if rejected. A rejection may be challenged or clarified through the competent registry and, where appropriate, the commercial court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Registration Evidence and Complete Post-Incorporation Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent RCS greffe, INPI, French tax administration, and the company's depositary bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the SIREN, SIRET, Kbis extract, NAF code, and final beneficial ownership confirmation. Activate the permanent bank account, release deposited capital, issue shares, maintain the share register and register of shareholder movements, and adopt the first board or shareholder resolutions permitted by the articles. Register for corporate tax, VAT if applicable, payroll obligations, and accounting records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct post-registration data through the INPI modification formalité, notify the tax administration of classification errors, and update the RCS or beneficial ownership register promptly after any governance or ownership change.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a non-industrial, office-based revenue-based financing company. If the company later operates physical premises or a regulated financial activity, the relevant authorities may include the local prefecture, Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL), ACPR, or AMF.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general manufacturing or industrial operating permit is required for the stated office-based financing activity. Any ACPR or AMF authorisation, registration, or notification must be assessed separately against the actual financing, fund-management, credit, payment, and solicitation model.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition; local environmental permitting functions are generally administered through the competent prefecture and DREAL
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt or not applicable for ordinary office-based financial services with no industrial installation, manufacturing process, material storage, or controlled emissions
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No sector-specific industrial wastewater, VOC, or process-emission thresholds apply to ordinary office operations. The company must comply with general waste separation, hazardous-waste handling where applicable, building utility, and occupational health requirements. Any later industrial installation may require an installation classée pour la protection de l'environnement (ICPE) review and applicable prefectural environmental permits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No industrial clearance is required for ordinary leased office premises beyond landlord and building compliance. The premises must satisfy French fire-safety and accessibility rules applicable to its classification, including emergency exits, evacuation arrangements, fire equipment, and electrical safety. Workplace risk assessment and the document unique d'évaluation des risques professionnels are required for employees. Structural load inspections are required only where the premises, equipment, storage, or works create a relevant structural risk.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS entities obtain SIREN from INSEE upon incorporation followed by SIRET; non-resident entities register for VAT via formal declaration exceeding threshold; TIN is SIREN/SIRET number
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections; French SAS subject to mandatory entity-level taxation under Impôt sur les Sociétés regime

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing for B2B via PEPES platform with API integration and digital stamping for large taxpayers

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside EU and offshore services with no French establishment; requires proof of export and non-EU destination
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims attract penalties up to 80% of tax due plus interest; retrospective clawback with potential criminal prosecution

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) under the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier, CMF), with the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) as the banking supervisory arm and the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) responsible for external financial policy; EU Treaty provisions on free movement of capital (TFEU Arts. 63-66) are directly applicable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible within the Eurosystem. France applies EU-wide capital liberalization with no exchange controls on current or capital account operations inside the EEA; non-EU flows are also freely convertible but attract statutory declaration duties and, in narrow cases, prior authorization under CMF L152-1 to L152-7 and R152-1 et seq. Profit remittances by an SAS are unrestricted: dividends may flow abroad under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (0% withholding where conditions are met) or a 25% treaty-reduced rate otherwise; practical hurdles are limited to UBO registration, demonstrable economic substance, and Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender ratio or mandatory conversion applies to export receipts. French residents receiving cross-border funds must, however, file an electronic transfer declaration (TSC — Déclaration de transfert de sommes) with the Banque de France for each transaction or aggregated series of transactions equal to or exceeding EUR 12,500, via the OneGate platform under CMF R152-3. Proceeds remain fully disposable in EUR or any foreign currency and may be retained offshore only insofar as they are declared for French corporate tax and BOP statistical purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole SA (LCL / Crédit Agricole CIB)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. EU-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (e.g., Qonto, Recyclib, or pan-EU EMIs passporting into France under EMD2) can operate as effective SEPA collection and euro-disbursement rails, and some offer proprietary FX conversion. Legal constraint: an EMI cannot hold client funds for lending, grant trade credit, or otherwise act as a credit institution without a separate ACPR credit license, and safeguarded client balances may not be reinvested in the treasury portfolio. Feasibility rating: Medium — acceptable for daily receipts and payouts, but a full-service tier-1 bank is mandatory for the capital escrow, drawdown facility, and FX-hedging lines.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence mandate applies. For the initial corporate onboarding of a Medium-Risk_Enhanced SAS, French banks require at least one legal representative, or a French-resident duly authorized agent holding a notarized and apostilled power of attorney, to attend an in-person interview at the branch; remote video onboarding is occasionally permitted by BNP Paribas and Société Générale for simple structures but is not a reliable default for a cross-border financing vehicle. A face-to-face meeting materially shortens compliance turnaround and is treated as the safe base case.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SAS presents as a royalty-financing fund without a regulated banking license, raising the CMF L511-1/L511-2 banking-monopoly red flag (suspected illegal credit activity).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French counsel legal opinion characterizing the arrangement as non-banking proprietary revenue-based financing; executed funding contracts with the digital-brand portfolio; audited annual accounts proving the absence of retail deposits; ISIC 6499 explanatory letter; corporate articles (statuts) demonstrating that funds are proprietary and not third-party savings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) are non-EEA or offshore-resident, triggering enhanced due diligence under the French AML/CFT regime (Monetary and Financial Code L561-1 et seq.).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled UBO registry declaration (RCS extract from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce); source-of-wealth memorandum with bank statements of each UBO; tax residence certificates for all shareholders; passport copies certified by a French consulate; organizational chart of the whole ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-cadence outbound SWIFT MT103 wires to foreign digital-brand counterparties may be flagged as unusual or potentially suspicious payment activity by the bank's transaction monitoring system.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contractual waterfall of the revenue-based financing model; underlying cash-flow schedule sent to the bank in advance; FX hedge confirmations evidencing real commercial purpose; internal AML/CFT manual covering sanctions screening, PEP checks, and transaction limits; statutory auditor (Commissaire aux comptes) certificate validating treasury movements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Apparent mismatch between the modest share capital (no minimum for an SAS) and expected treasury volume, raising concern about a shell vehicle or money-laundering conduit.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French registered-office lease recorded in the RCS; local corporate officer mandate; parent/beneficial owner comfort letter; annual budget and projected cash-flow forecast; an opening balance sheet demonstrating the economic substance of the financing activity; references from a previous onboarding bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route euro capital injections via TARGET2 through SWIFT MT103; for multi-currency or USD flows use correspondent banking with an MT202/MT103 COVER. State the Banque de France balance-of-payments purpose code (F2 for equity injection, F4 or F7 for shareholder loans and hybrid advances) and trigger the electronic TSC declaration on OneGate for any amount ≥ EUR 12,500. The bank will require the SAS board resolution (extrait du procès-verbal), the share issuance deed or hybrid-financing agreement, and confirmation that the remitter is the declared UBO or the group treasury entity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer (standard or instant SCT/Inst) for euro disbursements within the EEA; SWIFT MT103 for USD/GBP and non-EEA euro trade payouts with full structured beneficiary data (50k/59a) and pre-screening; standby or commercial Letters of Credit governed by UCP 600 for larger trade settlements requiring documentary security; and SEPA Core/B2B Direct Debit mandates for recurring royalty-advance recoveries from funded counterparties. The SAS's French IBAN/BIC should only be used as the settlement originator or beneficiary, never as an intermediary transit account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward (Outright) EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CNY executed under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a French or EEA banking counterparty
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) on non-fully-convertible or restricted currencies (e.g., EUR/CNH, EUR/TRY) where settlement is in EUR, subject to EMIR margin rules
Cross-Currency Swap (FX Swap or CCS) converting USD-denominated royalty streams into EURIBOR-floating euro receipts for balance-sheet liquidity stabilization
FX Option Collar / Zero-Premium Collar to cap conversion cost while preserving upside on uncertain royalty inflows

All OTC derivatives entered as a French Non-Financial Counterparty are subject to EMIR trade reporting to a registered trade repository, and, if the aggregate clearing threshold is exceeded, mandatory central clearing through LCH SA for eligible euro-denominated instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of the annual accounts by shareholders at the Annual General Meeting (AGOA) and recording of the minutes; may be done by written consultation where the articles of association so permit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders of the SAS; minutes kept in the statutory minute book (no government filing is collected at this step)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year end; calendar-year entity: by 30 June; a reasoned court order may extend this period (C. com. L.232-2)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit accounts within 6 months: 6 months' imprisonment and €75,000 fine for the SAS President (C. com. L.244-1); no lawful dividend distribution can occur without approved accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of the approved annual accounts (balance sheet, income statement, notes and management report) with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, filed electronically via the INPI Guichet Unique (GUCE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month of shareholder approval and no later than 7 months after fiscal year end; calendar-year entity: approval by 30 June, deposit by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to €5,000 for the company (Décret n°2020-1192); criminal fine up to €4,000 per natural-person director and €20,000 for the legal entity (C. com. L.242-11); non-filing is publicised on the RCS extract and may trigger court-ordered compliance or strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 2065-SD declaration of results with IS schedules, Form 2059 ancillary schedules and balance for payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - mandatory e-filing through the corporate file-transfer service (EFI / EDI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year taxpayer: by the 2nd working day after 1 May (usually 3-5 May); non-calendar fiscal year: within 3 months of the closing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: 10% penalty on assessed tax if filed within 30 days of the formal notice and 40% thereafter, plus 0.2% monthly late interest; €150 fixed fine per missing or inaccurate schedule (Art. 1728-0 A CGI); bad-faith omissions attract 80% or 160% surcharges and potential criminal prosecution under Art. 1741 CGI

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: CFE (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises) local territorial contribution: annual return and payment of the balance due
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP - Service des Impôts des Entreprises (collecting for the commune and inter-municipal grouping)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Balance due by 15 December of the assessment year; a 50% advance instalment is due by 15 June when the prior-year CFE exceeded €3,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment penalty plus 0.2% monthly interest; enforced collection (avis de mise en recouvrement) may freeze and seize bank accounts; continued default exposes the entity to registry enforcement and dissolution actions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO confirmation and 30-day update of the register of beneficial owners (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés / Greffe, filed via the INPI Guichet Unique (GUCE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any change in a person holding >25% of capital, voting rights or ultimate control: declaration within 30 days; annual confirmation accompanies the deposit of annual accounts by 31 July for a calendar-year entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of €37,500 for the legal entity and €7,500 for natural persons for missing, incomplete or inaccurate declarations; deliberate false statements expose directors to money-laundering-related imprisonment; the registry may refuse further filings and initiate de-registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration of share transfers (number, dates, parties, price and object of each cession of shares registered during the preceding calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP - tax office of the company's place of taxation (filed through the corporate e-filing portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of the year following each calendar year of transfers (Art. 1649 quater-0 B bis CGI, introduced by LF 2024)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Flat fine of €500 per unreported, incomplete or inaccurate transfer, capped at €10,000 per calendar year; non-compliance increases exposure during tax audit and transfer re-characterisation

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory for an SAS exceeding at least two of three thresholds at balance-sheet date: total assets > €4,000,000; net turnover > €8,000,000; average workforce > 50 employees (C. com. L.232-6 and D.232-1). An SAS controlling one or more subsidiaries exceeding these group thresholds must also appoint an auditor; since the PACTE reform, sub-threshold SAS may waive the auditor unless partners representing at least 10% of capital petition the court to appoint one (C. com. L.227-9-1). A non-bank revenue-based financing vehicle without a regulated banking licence carries no prudential supervisory audit mandate.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual (parent-company) accounts: French GAAP per the Plan Comptable Général (ANC Regulation 2014-03 with annual updates); consolidated accounts of listed or controlling eligible parents: IFRS as endorsed by Regulation (EC) No 1606/2002. Annual accounts must include balance sheet, income statement, notes, management report and allocation-of-results proposal.
